title: Patience Through Rejection
paragraphs: For years, Prophet Nuh called his people toward monotheism, facing consistent rejection and ridicule from a community that grew increasingly hostile toward his message with each passing generation.

Rather than abandoning his mission after facing repeated failure, he continued his efforts patiently, understanding that his responsibility was to deliver the message clearly, regardless of how few people ultimately accepted it.

Modern readers studying this account often focus less on the eventual outcome and more on the sustained patience required to continue an unpopular mission across an entire lifetime of visible rejection.

This story is frequently referenced today when discussing perseverance in the face of discouragement, illustrating that faithful effort retains value independent of whether it produces immediately visible results.
